Attached: 1 image

For the CrewAI builders: your crew can answer the phone.
1. One POST to api.callnode.io/v1/numbers → a live US/CA number
2. call.answered kicks off your crew with caller context
3. transcript.turn streams every turn into your agents
4. call.ended hands off the summary and outcome
No phone system to manage — your orchestration stays in CrewAI. The phone is just another input. #VoiceAI #AIAgents
